comparisons.peer_summary: AMD's operating results are subject to uneven quarterly and seasonal sales patterns, with a large portion of sales occurring in the last month of the quarter and higher net revenue historically in the second half of the year, making revenue prediction difficult and increasing the risk of unanticipated variations.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD disclose historical trends of higher net revenue in the second half of the year. However, Intel specifically notes that revenue accelerates in the third quarter and peaks in the fourth quarter, and explicitly confirms that the 2024 trend was directionally consistent with this pattern. AMD also describes a second-half dominance but adds that a significant portion of its sales occur in the last month of the quarter, creating uneven patterns that make revenue prediction more difficult and increasing the risk of unanticipated variations.

sentences.text: Historically, our net revenue has typically been higher in the second half of the year than in the first half of the year, accelerating in the third quarter and peaking in the fourth quarter.
In 2024 and 2023, our net revenue seasonality was directionally consistent with this historical trend.

For example, historically, our net revenue has been generally higher in the second half of the year than in the first half of the year, although market conditions and product transitions could impact these trends.
A large portion of our quarterly sales have historically been made in the last month of the quarter.
